A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the viscous instability of stratified microchannels can be controlled to generate high frequency mixing, emulsification and dispersion of viscous fluids in the presence of interfacial effects.

interfacial waves can break and generate ligaments in microsystems, which can be used for mixing, particle synthesis or emulsion production.
